variants.maintainer_notes: New variant: the RAM variant's command with --write-flash. openFPGALoader writes the SPI flash through the ECP5's JTAG port. Not tried on hardware. Device selection (2026-11-04): --busdev-num ${BUS}:${DEV} added so openFPGALoader opens the device the engine chose, not the first one with these USB IDs. Low risk, so tested is unchanged: openFPGALoader's FTDI drivers (MPSSE, bitbang, CH552) open the device by bus and address when given (src/ftdipp_mpsse.cpp, ftdi_usb_open_bus_addr); not tried on hardware. USB filter (2026-11-05): the board's FT231XQ keeps its factory name: the maker's README (github.com/cheyao/icepi-zero gateware/README.md, 46f2b32) tells users to pick "FT231X USB UART" in the browser's device list, and DIAMOND.md names the FT231XQ. A factory name, so the match is possible, and a ULX3S whose chip was never named matches too.
variants.user_notes: Its USB chip reports the chip's factory name, FT231X USB UART, as other boards with that chip may.
